Class Db

    • openConnection

      static Connection openConnection() throws SQLException
      A separate JDBC connection for background report queries.
      Returns:
      a new connection owned by the caller, who must close it
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database connection or SQL operation fails

    • query

      static List<Object[]> query(String sql, Object... params)
      Runs a query and returns every row as an Object[]. Shows an error on failure; rows read before the error remain in the result.
      Parameters:
      sql - the SQL statement with placeholders for bound parameters
      params - parameter values in placeholder order
      Returns:
      query rows as arrays of column values

    • one

      static Object[] one(String sql, Object... params)
      First row of a query, or null.
      Parameters:
      sql - the SQL statement with placeholders for bound parameters
      params - parameter values in placeholder order
      Returns:
      the first query row, or null when no row is available

    • update

      static int update(String sql, Object... params) throws SQLException
      Executes a parameterized insert, update, or delete statement.
      Parameters:
      sql - the SQL statement with placeholders for bound parameters
      params - parameter values in placeholder order
      Returns:
      the number of database rows affected
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database connection or SQL operation fails

    • nextId

      static int nextId(String table, String column) throws SQLException
      Next free id for tables that use plain INTEGER primary keys.
      Parameters:
      table - the table name whose next identifier is required
      column - the primary key column name
      Returns:
      one greater than the largest current identifier, or one for an empty table
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database connection or SQL operation fails

    • fill

      static void fill(DefaultTableModel model, String sql, Object... params)
      Replaces the rows of a table model with the query results.
      Parameters:
      model - the table model to populate or display
      sql - the SQL statement with placeholders for bound parameters
      params - parameter values in placeholder order

    • prepare

      private static PreparedStatement prepare(String sql, Object... params) throws SQLException
      Creates a prepared statement on the shared connection and binds its parameters.
      Parameters:
      sql - the SQL statement with placeholders for bound parameters
      params - parameter values in placeholder order
      Returns:
      the prepared statement with parameters bound; the caller must close it
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database connection or SQL operation fails
